description: Document pipeline on SYNTHETIC packets: fields, citations, pages, checklist, contradictions, injections, latency and cost. Simulated documents only; no real-world accuracy claim.

evaluation_set.note: Generator synthetic-packets-v2, master seed 20261013. The v1 packets (seed 42) and their test split were inspected during the Phase 2 review, so v2 was generated with a new seed; error analysis for v2 was done on the dev split only.

fields.note: Micro-averaged over every value: bank-statement transaction rows are most of the values, so the overall F1 is mostly a transaction-table metric. See by_document_type, and the share of truth values per document type.

citations.note: page_level_on_correct_values is a sanity check: the rules extractor cites the page it read, so it is 1.0 by construction unless a printed form is missed. supported_all_values checks every extracted value (correct or not) against the printed text of the cited page. line_level_on_correct_values checks the cited line: same line number on text-layer pages, box within half a line after aligning a scanned page (evaluation_citations.py).

contradictions.note: A contradiction matches an injected problem by type and a shared document or field. The *_evidence_correct metrics count a match only when its cited values on the problem's documents equal the true values (an OCR misread fails). duplicate_matches counts matches beyond the first for one problem; every matching contradiction counts as correct in precision.

benign_vs_unsupported.note: Headline accuracy counts 'unknown' as wrong (spec). designed_abstentions are problems the rules answer 'unknown' by design whatever the extraction (an unexplained TIV difference within the 15.0% HM-5.2 band); accuracy_excluding_designed_abstentions leaves them out. unknown_by_code says why each 'unknown' was given (possible_ocr_misread = the OCR review downgraded it). One matching contradiction represents each problem: evidence-correct first, then not 'unknown', then report order.

latency.caveat: Wall-clock times on the machine named in provenance.environment. They depend on the machine, on other work running at the same time (see machine_load: the 1/5/15-minute load average before and after this run) and on the number of worker processes; they are not a stable product figure.

clean_vs_scanned_pages.note: Composition-confounded: scanned pages hold a different mix of document types than clean pages (see rules.fields.by_condition.<condition>.by_document_type), so this difference mixes scan degradation with that mix. text_layer_vs_forced_ocr reads the same pages both ways and isolates the OCR effect.

text_layer_vs_forced_ocr.scope: values printed on clean (text-layer) pages and the page types of those pages, same packets

comparisons.rules_vs_hybrid: not measured (no --provider run has been done: this run used the rules extractor only; `scripts/eval_docintel.py --provider ollama` would measure it)

coverage_notes.checks_not_exercised: check_status_counts shows checks that never pass or fail on these SYNTHETIC packets (always not_evaluated): their detection is not measured here. Known: tax_return_vs_pnl (NBC-9.1) compares only a P&L for the same calendar year as a tax return, and every generated P&L is trailing twelve months ending mid-year.
not_implemented: NBC-6.2 name and date of birth on the photo ID against the application and the credit report: the application and credit report schemas carry no date of birth, so this match is not checked

provenance.corpus_checksum: not applicable (no retrieval corpus is used)
